scenes.title: Coffee before the market
scenes.place: the café, before the night market
opening: The café is busy with the before-dinner crowd, but Alice has the corner table and a cup she hasn't touched.
She turns it a quarter turn, then back, and waits until you're sitting before she looks up.
choices: Can I ask you something before the others get here?
Mia's meeting us, right? She's never late unless it's on purpose.

cues.proposition: The user asked Alice about Emily before the market.

fallback_lines.alice: Ask me when we're walking. I think better when I'm moving, and I've been sitting still too long.

scenes.title: The night market
opening: The market is steam and string lights and two songs playing over each other.
Mia finds you first and puts a paper cup in your hand before she says hello.
Alice and Emily come from opposite ends of the row and don't quite look at each other.
choices: @emily Okay, honest — who's been avoiding who?
Mia, what do you think? You've been quiet for four whole seconds.
Nobody has to answer that. We can just eat.

cues.proposition: The user is closer to Alice than to Emily.
Mia can feel the tension between Alice and Emily.

fallback_lines.alice: I'm not avoiding anyone. I'm standing right here, which is the opposite, last I checked.
fallback_lines.emily: I'm not the one who went quiet. Ask her.
fallback_lines.mia: I think we eat first. Everything's less tragic with something fried.
